outcomes.CANDIDATE: all validation and confirmation criteria pass -> NOT a release: first a preregistered paper session on new data (Binance Spot testnet klines, at least 12 weeks after registration, S06/S07 runner with the operator's keys) with its own criteria; only then S08 criteria for a new release
outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 8 closed trades on validation, no configuration eligible on development, or validation passes and confirmation fails

validation: closed_trades_per_year <= 30% of the momentum_v1 baseline on the same window
costs <= 50% of the gross result (net + costs)

buy_and_hold.description: constant LONG at max_exposure for the whole window (context only, not a criterion)

momentum_v1.description: btcusdt-momentum-v1: threshold 0.0, horizon 6 (reference for the turnover criterion, as in E01-E04)

checkpoints.check: Feature and strategy causality: tests/test_daily_trend.py green on the run commit (daily close = last bar closed before the 00:00 decision, undefined across missing days, exposure kept between decisions, hysteresis and regime rules, fail closed).
Grid of 12 configurations reproducible (same ledger digests on two runs in separate output directories); selection.json from development only, committed before validation is run.
report.json per window for the selected configuration and the baselines with the declared metrics; outcome justified on the criteria.
If CANDIDATE: preregistered testnet paper session specification before any S08 step; else closing evidence in the backlog.

spec.command: python -m crypto_decision_lab.daily_experiment develop --spec config/experiments/E05-daily-trend-v1.json; commit selection.json; python -m crypto_decision_lab.daily_experiment evaluate --spec config/experiments/E05-daily-trend-v1.json
spec.hypothesis: On daily closes, BTCUSDT trends persist long enough that a long-only rule (enter when the n-day return is above a threshold while the close is above its m-day average; exit when the n-day return turns negative or the close falls under the average) earns per trade well above the round-trip cost (fee 0.10% + slippage 0.05% per side), so the net return is positive out of sample.

inputs.engine: crypto_decision_lab.simulation (S03), hourly steps; gaps acknowledged as in crypto_decision_lab.release.evaluate_backtest
forbidden: BTCUSDT-1h-forward-v1 and any path under data/forward (CP08 reserved)
inputs.protocol: crypto_decision_lab.experiment_protocol (two phases, E01 criteria) with the minimum closed trades of this spec
inputs.strategy: crypto_decision_lab.daily_trend.DailyTrendStrategy, registered as daily_trend in simulation.STRATEGIES. One decision per UTC day on the 00:00 event; daily close of day D-1 = close of its 23:00 bar; d_momentum = close(D-1)/close(D-1-n) - 1; d_trend = close(D-1)/SMA_m - 1; between decisions the exposure is kept; missing feature on a decision bar -> FLAT. Features computed over the whole admitted frame (days before a window only warm up).

validation.use: one evaluation of the selected configuration

origin.data_seen_before_registration: All three windows of BTCUSDT-1h-raw-v1 were already evaluated for four hourly strategies (S08, E01-E04) and for buy and hold (development -4.0%, validation +103.2%, confirmation -5.4%). E03 development results favoured the longer regime average (720h = 30 days over 168h). No daily feature and no daily_trend configuration were evaluated on real data before registration.
origin.deviation: E01-E04 (momentum, breakout patterns, mean reversion on hourly decisions) were all rejected by the cost criterion: the gross result per trade stayed between 0.2 and 0.9 on a 250 position against a round-trip cost of about 0.75 and an acceptance level of about 1.5. E05 keeps the cost model and lengthens the decision horizon to one day, so each trade targets a multi-day move.

spec.prompt: Lavora esclusivamente sull'esperimento E05 del repository Crypto Decision Lab. Leggi Crypto_Decision_Lab_PRD.md e questa specifica; verifica che il suo sha256 (fine riga LF) coincida con quello registrato nella riga E05 del backlog e che status sia PREREGISTERED. Esegui CP-E05.0 (pytest tests/test_daily_trend.py), poi la fase develop, committa selection.json, poi la fase evaluate; ripeti con la fase all in una cartella di output diversa e confronta i ledger_sha256 (CP-E05.1). Non modificare specifica, strategia o runner dopo aver visto un risultato: ogni modifica richiede una nuova versione preregistrata. Riporta per CP-E05.0-3 comando, atteso, osservato ed evidenza nel formato di handoff del PRD e aggiorna la riga E05 del backlog con l'esito.

selection.rule: On development only: among configurations with closed_trades >= 12, the highest net_return_pct; ties -> fewer closed trades -> grid order. If none qualifies the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE and validation is not run. selection.json is committed to the repository before validation and confirmation are evaluated.

threats: Few trades: daily decisions give roughly 5-20 closed trades per year, so the minimum numbers are lowered to 12 (selection) and 8 (validation) from the 30 and 15 of E01-E04. Statistical evidence is weaker and one or two large trades can decide the outcome; the report shows the gross result per trade and the comparison with buy and hold for that reason.

Fifth experiment on the same snapshot: every window was already seen, and it is known that buy and hold gained +103% on the validation window. A long-only trend rule benefits from that by construction; passing validation is weak evidence and the confirmation window (buy and hold -5.4%) is the harder test. The guard is the forward paper session required by the CANDIDATE outcome.
Grid of 12 on one asset: multiple-comparison bias on development; validation and confirmation are evaluated once.

No holding horizon and no price stop: the exit is the daily rule only, checked once per day; an intraday crash is absorbed until the next 00:00 decision. max_exposure 0.5 caps the size and the drawdown criterion is the registered guard.
